ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominate >90% of the visible fluke area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to barnacle clusters and water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark contiguous region across both lobes; distinct white high-contrast clusters localized at the far-left and far-right distal margins (tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; estimated 45-degree angle of convergence with deep penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of non-uniform sharp peaks and deep valleys along the entire span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-intensity pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the lateral margins and distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) on the lateral tips causing significant localized surface distortion.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity white speckling across the lower fluke regions caused by water spray/cavitation.
